title: 賦得江邊柳
author: Yu Xuanji
yearLabel: Tang dynasty · exact composition year unknown
context: A complete poem attributed to Yu Xuanji in the University of Tokyo's facsimile with a title dated 1899, PDF p. 3. Its complete verse and following boundary were checked visually against that scan and an earlier saved view of a similar 1920 National Central Library scan. The latter's catalogue credits Wu Weiye, although its printed heading names Yu Xuanji; the reason for the conflict is not established. The linked Wikisource transcription of a different Siku quanshu edition was a comparison aid. The scans may be related and are not independent proof of textual descent or authorship. Punctuation, reading lines and some character forms are normalized; this is not a diplomatic transcription. China is associated with Yu, not asserted as the composition place; the exact year is unknown. The facsimile reads ‘瀟瀟風雨夜’; the Wikisource comparison has ‘蕭蕭風雨夜’ and records several other alternate characters.

text:
翠色連荒岸，
煙姿入遠樓。
影鋪秋水面，
花落釣人頭。
根老藏魚窟，
枝低繫客舟。
瀟瀟風雨夜，
驚夢復添愁。

text:
羞日遮羅袖，
愁春懶起粧。
易求無價寶，
難得有心郎。
枕上潛垂淚，
花間暗斷腸。
自能窺宋玉，
何必恨王昌。
